answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The velvet holds work receipts rather than names, so the tundra of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, converted to a slow vesting stream, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. By the dune of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
